title: Add Lequait/dsh-context-rescue (rescues a session the window already refused)
body:
Adds [dsh-context-rescue](https://github.com/Lequait/dsh-context-rescue) under **Sessions & Messages**.

It is the after-the-fact counterpart of a preventive compactor: when a request is refused for
exceeding the context window, it re-checks the gateway message the built-in classifier misses,
takes the real window out of that message, folds the oldest span into one checkpoint **without a
model call**, rewrites the session surface, and asks the host to retry the failed step once.
`/rescue` and `/rescue-status` expose the same path by hand, and it does not register the
`compaction` service, so a preventive compactor keeps its slot.

Evidence is in the repository: 131 unit tests, and the fold is replayed through the host's own
`Session` class over 216 captured session logs (70 folded, 0 failures) plus the real app boot.

edits.insert: - [Lequait/dsh-context-rescue](https://github.com/Lequait/dsh-context-rescue) - Rescues a session the host already refused for exceeding the context window: it detects the refusal, folds the oldest span into one checkpoint with no model call, retries the failed step once, and reports what it did through /rescue and /rescue-status.
- [Lequait/dsh-context-rescue](https://github.com/Lequait/dsh-context-rescue) — 抢救已经被上下文窗口拒掉的会话：识别失败信息、零模型把最旧的一段历史折成一个检查点、重试失败的那一步，并用 /rescue 与 /rescue-status 报告做了什么。
edits.message: 把 dsh-context-rescue 加进「会话与消息」
